scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @cybersource-tester/domain build && pnpm exec concurrently -k "pnpm --filter @cybersource-tester/server dev" "pnpm --filter @cybersource-tester/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cybersource-tester/domain build && pnpm --filter @cybersource-tester/server build && pnpm --filter @cybersource-tester/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @cybersource-tester/domain build && pnpm --filter @cybersource-tester/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @cybersource-tester/web typecheck
scripts.test:sandbox: CYBERSOURCE_LIVE_TESTS=true pnpm exec vitest run apps/server/tests/live
